review_boundary: Bounded source-qualified review of two explicit RAW bootstrap callers. This adds post-release ownership records; it does not recertify the sealed T14 foundation or change its historical source pins, classification counts, verdicts or baseline.
hash_normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization. The unchanged partial source digest equals its baseline Git object bytes; the new recovery source already uses LF. Ambient Windows checkout line endings are not review identity.

reviewed_conditions: Source is locked and must be the exact requested upload's BLOCKED pipeline at FETCHING_MARKET_DATA.
Requested tickers come from retained semantic scope membership; all must exist in the retained source raw rows.
The exact selected source row bodies are fingerprinted before copying; retained upload ID, source pipeline/scope, requested tickers and raw row ID mapping remain explicit lineage.
The RAW bootstrap mutation fence is established before adding a derived UploadRun or RawCompanyRow. Exact retained source-row fingerprint is supplied as source_file evidence.

The source pipeline, raw rows, semantic scope and market context are not written. The derived upload is handed to the normal pipeline admission path for a new frozen cutoff, configuration and availability policy.

No intermediate commit occurs in the caller. Enqueue failure rolls back the derived upload and rows in the caller's transaction; a locked source serializes duplicate admission, and existing recovery lineage coalesces repeated calls.
Existing baseline operation requires the exact source upload's BLOCKED pipeline at FETCHING_MARKET_DATA and explicit exclusions equal to all current readiness blockers.
Unresolved instrument identity cannot be excluded; readiness must cover retained scope membership, and at least one included ticker must remain.
Included source rows must exactly match reviewed included tickers. The fingerprint binds the retained source upload rows, while lineage records the exact copied source-to-derived row IDs.
The RAW bootstrap mutation fence precedes derived input insertion and receives retained source rows as source_file evidence.

The caller writes a separate derived upload and raw rows without committing or changing the original pipeline/checkpoint. This review records the pre-existing caller; its source and behavior are unchanged in this release.

baseline_missing_inventory_fixture.finding: The unchanged baseline inventory reader requires an artifact absent from the baseline Git tree. Its fixture errors are separate from the additive production-adoption source review gate. No historical review is synthesized, source pin refreshed, test skipped or gate weakened.
